text: e& (Emirates Telecommunications Group, the rebranded Etisalat) is 60% owned by the Emirates Investment Authority (EIA), the fund to which the UAE Federal Government transferred its holding and which is ultimately controlled by the Federal Government.
short: e& is 60% owned by the Emirates Investment Authority (UAE federal government)

source.name: e& (Emirates Telecommunications Group Company PJSC): Integrated Annual Report 2022, notes to the consolidated financial statements
source.quote: transferred its 60% holding in the Company to the Emirates Investment Authority with effect from 1 January 2008, which is ultimately controlled by the UAE Federal Government

additionalSources.name: AGBI (Arabian Gulf Business Insight): Etisalat / e& company profile (undated, opened 29 September 2026)
additionalSources.quote: The ownership structure changed in 1983 when the UAE government held a 60% share. The remainder is publicly traded
